CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_uskoci_auth_user_created()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  -- No email fallback. An email local part is frequently a real name or a handle the
  -- person never chose to publish, and this value is shown to other users.
  profile_name text := COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name'), ''), 'USKOČI korisnik');
  -- No invented city. Empty is honest and the app can ask; a guessed city is a false
  -- fact that feeds discovery and matching.
  profile_city text := COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'city'), ''), '');
  profile_phone text := COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(NEW.phone), ''), NULLIF(trim(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'phone'), ''), '');
  initial_mode text := CASE WHEN NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'mode' = 'worker' THEN 'worker' ELSE 'requester' END;
  initial_skills text[] := public.metadata_text_array(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->'skills');
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.app_accounts(id,email,full_name,city,phone,active_mode,onboarding_complete)
  VALUES(NEW.id,COALESCE(NEW.email,''),profile_name,profile_city,profile_phone,initial_mode,false)
  ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
    email=EXCLUDED.email,
    full_name=CASE WHEN public.app_accounts.full_name='' THEN EXCLUDED.full_name ELSE public.app_accounts.full_name END,
    city=CASE WHEN public.app_accounts.city='' THEN EXCLUDED.city ELSE public.app_accounts.city END,
    phone=CASE WHEN public.app_accounts.phone='' THEN EXCLUDED.phone ELSE public.app_accounts.phone END;

  -- PKG-027d: no headline or bio is written for the person. Other people read these fields as the
  -- person's own words, so they start empty and only the person fills them.
  INSERT INTO public.app_profiles(account_id,kind,display_name,city,headline,bio,radius_km,available_now)
  VALUES(NEW.id,'REQUESTER',profile_name,profile_city,'','',10,false)
  ON CONFLICT(account_id,kind) DO NOTHING;

  INSERT INTO public.app_profiles(account_id,kind,display_name,city,headline,bio,skills,radius_km,available_now)
  VALUES(NEW.id,'WORKER',profile_name,profile_city,'','',initial_skills,15,false)
  ON CONFLICT(account_id,kind) DO NOTHING;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER on_uskoci_auth_user_created AFTER INSERT ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_uskoci_auth_user_created()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_uskoci_auth_user_updated()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.id=OLD.id AND OLD.deleted_at IS NULL AND NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.closure_executions_v5 e JOIN private.closure_actions_v5 a ON a.generation=e.generation AND a.account_id=e.account_id
      WHERE e.account_id=NEW.id AND e.state='EXECUTING' AND a.kind='AUTH_IDENTITY_ERASE' AND a.state='DISPATCHED') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  UPDATE public.app_accounts
  SET email=COALESCE(NEW.email,email),
      phone=COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(NEW.phone),''),phone)
  WHERE id=NEW.id;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER on_uskoci_auth_user_updated AFTER UPDATE OF email, phone ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_uskoci_auth_user_updated()

 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- The existing owner guard checks the resulting owner. A second narrow guard
 -- prevents moving a historical copy away from its original closing account.
 IF (to_jsonb(OLD)->TG_ARGV[0]) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(NEW)->TG_ARGV[0])
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'F01_OWNER_IMMUTABLE';END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_signed_binding_requeue_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_valid boolean:=false;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT'
    OR NEW.result->>'dispatchAuthority'<>'NONE'
    OR NEW.result->>'notificationAuthority'<>'NONE' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='work_taxonomy_need_bindings_v1' THEN
    IF NEW.result->>'status'<>'BOUND_NEED_REVISION' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
    -- Recheck CURRENT requester revision and category. The binder holds the
    -- same Need row lock and has just inserted the signed snapshot.
    SELECT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM public.needs n
      JOIN private.work_taxonomy_need_snapshots snap
        ON snap.need_id=n.id AND snap.need_revision=n.revision
       AND snap.category_id=n.category_id
      WHERE n.id=NEW.need_id AND n.requester_account_id=NEW.owner_account_id
        AND n.revision=NEW.need_revision AND n.category_id=NEW.category_id
        AND n.status IN ('PUBLISHED','SELECTION')
        AND n.remaining_search_closed_at IS NULL
        AND (n.response_deadline IS NULL OR n.response_deadline>statement_timestamp())
        AND snap.reviewed_by_requester AND snap.classification_state='CONFIRMED'
    ) INTO v_valid;
    IF v_valid THEN
      -- Requeue, not dispatch. The next scheduler tick still enforces every
      -- signed service/scope, capacity, area, time, budget and duplicate gate.
      PERFORM private.enqueue_dispatch(NEW.need_id,statement_timestamp());
    END IF;
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1' THEN
    IF NEW.result->>'status'<>'BOUND_WORKER_SERVICES' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
    SELECT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM public.app_profiles p
      JOIN private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 m
        ON m.worker_account_id=p.account_id
       AND m.source_review_id=NEW.source_review_id
       AND m.source_request_key=NEW.request_key
       AND m.active
      WHERE p.id=NEW.profile_id AND p.account_id=NEW.owner_account_id
        AND p.kind='WORKER' AND p.profile_status='ACTIVE'
    ) INTO v_valid;
    IF v_valid THEN
      -- Existing bounded/idempotent world-scoped requeue (max 200 Need rows).
      -- Nothing here grants an ability or emits a notification.
      PERFORM private.requeue_open_needs_for_worker_v5(NEW.owner_account_id);
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  -- Queue failures must never undo a verified owner Save/UUID receipt.
  -- Only a sanitized SQLSTATE; no account IDs, addresses, skills or task text.
  RAISE LOG 'TAXONOMY_BOUND_REQUEUE_FAILED:%',SQLSTATE;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER taxonomy_signed_worker_bound_requeue_v1 AFTER INSERT ON private.work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_signed_binding_requeue_v1()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ai_task_review_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
 if auth.role()='service_role' then
  if TG_OP in ('UPDATE','DELETE') and private.closure_redaction_allowed_v5(TG_RELID,TG_OP,to_jsonb(OLD),case when TG_OP='UPDATE' then to_jsonb(NEW) else null end) then
   if TG_OP='DELETE' then return OLD;end if;return NEW;
  end if;
 end if;
 raise exception 'TASK_REVIEW_IMMUTABLE' using errcode='55000'; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.account_lineage(p_account_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select coalesce((select l.lineage from private.account_lineage_v5 l where l.account_id = p_account_id), 'UNCLASSIFIED');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.account_visibility_world(p_account_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select case when coalesce(private.account_lineage(p_account_id), 'UNCLASSIFIED')
                in ('DEV_ACCEPTANCE_QA','SYNTHETIC_ACCEPTANCE_FIXTURE','OPERATOR',
                    -- PKG-029e, owner decision 2026-09-21 ("dok testiramo"): the owner's own accounts share the
                    -- test world while testing. Take these two out again before real users arrive.
                    'OWNER_PERSONAL','OWNER_BUSINESS') then 'TEST' else 'REAL' end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.closure_account_restricted(a uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ select exists(select 1 from private.account_closure_requests r where r.account_id=a
 and r.state in('READY','EXECUTING','FAILED','CLOSED')); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.closure_taxonomy_profile_erasing_v1(a uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT auth.role()='service_role' AND EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM private.closure_redaction_certificate_v5 c
 JOIN private.closure_executions_v5 e ON e.account_id=c.account_id AND e.generation=c.generation
 JOIN private.closure_actions_v5 ac ON ac.id=c.action_id AND ac.generation=e.generation
 WHERE c.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid() AND c.transaction_id=txid_current() AND c.account_id=a
 AND c.relation_oid='public.app_profiles'::regclass AND c.operation='UPDATE'
 AND c.patch@>'{"skills":[]}'::jsonb AND e.state='EXECUTING'
 AND ac.kind='RELATIONAL_REDACT' AND ac.state='DISPATCHED');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.enqueue_dispatch(p_need_id uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT statement_timestamp())
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  insert into private.dispatch_schedule (need_id, next_run_at)
  values (p_need_id, p_at)
  on conflict (need_id) do update
    set next_run_at = least(private.dispatch_schedule.next_run_at, excluded.next_run_at),
        updated_at = statement_timestamp();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.requeue_open_needs_for_worker_v5(p_account_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare v_need uuid; v_count integer := 0;
begin
  if p_account_id is null or not exists (
    select 1 from public.app_profiles p
     where p.account_id = p_account_id and p.kind = 'WORKER' and p.profile_status = 'ACTIVE') then
    return 0;
  end if;
  -- Same open set as the marketplace reader, the worker's own world only, never the worker's own tasks.
  -- Queueing is idempotent (enqueue_dispatch keeps the earlier run time), and the tick decides eligibility.
  for v_need in
    select n.id from public.needs n
     where n.status in ('PUBLISHED','SELECTION')
       and n.published_at is not null
       and n.remaining_search_closed_at is null
       and n.requester_account_id <> p_account_id
       and (n.response_deadline is null or n.response_deadline > statement_timestamp())
       and private.accounts_same_world(n.requester_account_id, p_account_id)
     order by n.published_at desc, n.id desc
     limit 200
  loop
    perform private.enqueue_dispatch(v_need, statement_timestamp());
    v_count := v_count + 1;
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_ai_document(cid uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion','WORKER_PROFILE_V1','conversationId',s.conversation_id,'accountId',s.account_id,
  'profileId',s.profile_id,'status',c.status,'profileStatus',coalesce((select p.profile_status from public.app_profiles p where p.id=s.profile_id),'DRAFT'),
  'revision',s.revision,'candidate',s.candidate,'safety',s.safety,
  'stale',s.base_hash<>private.worker_ai_source_hash(s.account_id),
  'messages',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',m.id,'role',m.role,'body',m.body,'sequence',m.sequence_no) order by m.sequence_no)
    from (select * from public.ai_messages where conversation_id=cid order by sequence_no desc limit 100) m),'[]'::jsonb),
  'turn',(select private.worker_ai_turn_document(t.turn_id) from private.worker_ai_turns t where t.conversation_id=cid order by t.created_at desc,t.turn_id desc limit 1),
  'review',(select r.envelope from private.worker_ai_reviews r where r.conversation_id=cid AND NOT(r.envelope ? 'classificationState') order by
    exists(select 1 from private.worker_ai_saves z where z.review_id=r.id) desc,r.created_at desc,r.id desc limit 1),
  'saved',(select z.receipt from private.worker_ai_saves z join private.worker_ai_reviews r on r.id=z.review_id where r.conversation_id=cid AND NOT(r.envelope ? 'classificationState') limit 1))
 from private.worker_ai_sessions s join public.ai_conversations c on c.id=s.conversation_id and c.account_id=s.account_id and c.purpose='PROFILE'
 where s.conversation_id=cid;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_ai_service_mode_context_v1(p_account_id uuid, p_conversation_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 s private.worker_ai_sessions; v_saved private.worker_ai_saves; v_previous record;
 v_current jsonb; v_item jsonb; v_projection jsonb; v_hints jsonb; v_source text;
 v_saved_services jsonb:='[]';v_draft_services jsonb:='[]';v_unresolved jsonb:='[]';
 v_count integer;v_category uuid;v_handoff jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO s FROM private.worker_ai_sessions
 WHERE account_id=p_account_id AND conversation_id=p_conversation_id;
 IF NOT FOUND OR s.base_hash IS DISTINCT FROM private.worker_ai_source_hash(p_account_id)
    OR jsonb_typeof(s.candidate->'skills') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKER_AI_NOT_EDITABLE' USING errcode='55000'; END IF;
 v_current:=private.worker_ai_initial(p_account_id);
 -- A STABLE reader observes one statement snapshot. The saved profile's source
 -- hash must still match the conversation base. The candidate may change bio,
 -- availability or other draft fields without turning catalog modes into consent.
 SELECT * INTO v_saved FROM private.worker_ai_saves saved
 WHERE saved.account_id=p_account_id AND saved.receipt->>'profileId'=s.profile_id::text
 ORDER BY saved.created_at DESC,saved.review_id DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND AND v_saved.receipt->'saved'='true'::jsonb
    AND v_saved.receipt->'authoritative'='true'::jsonb
    AND v_saved.receipt->>'profileStatus'='ACTIVE'
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.worker_ai_saves other
      WHERE other.account_id=p_account_id AND other.receipt->>'profileId'=s.profile_id::text
        AND other.created_at=v_saved.created_at AND other.review_id<>v_saved.review_id)
 THEN
   -- Same durable Save/review/batch/binding/current-consent chain as the applied
   -- saved-review continuity fix. Review expiry constrains the original Save;
   -- it does not expire a mode that the owner already saved.
   SELECT previous.*,binding.bound_at,batch.result AS batch_result INTO v_previous
   FROM private.worker_ai_reviews previous
   JOIN public.app_profiles profile ON profile.id=s.profile_id
     AND profile.account_id=p_account_id AND profile.kind='WORKER'
     AND profile.profile_status='ACTIVE' AND profile.updated_at<=v_saved.created_at
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1 binding
     ON binding.owner_account_id=p_account_id AND binding.profile_id=s.profile_id
     AND binding.request_key=v_saved.client_request_id AND binding.source_review_id=previous.id
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_review_batches_v1 batch
     ON batch.owner_account_id=p_account_id AND batch.request_key=v_saved.client_request_id
     AND batch.source_review_id=previous.id AND batch.purpose='WORKER_CAPABILITY'
   JOIN private.worker_execution_mode_choices choice
     ON choice.worker_profile_id=s.profile_id AND choice.worker_account_id=p_account_id
     AND choice.consent_source='EXPLICIT_PROFILE_REVIEW'
     AND choice.confirmed_at=binding.bound_at AND choice.updated_at=binding.bound_at
   WHERE previous.id=v_saved.review_id AND previous.account_id=p_account_id
     AND previous.envelope->>'profileId'=s.profile_id::text
     AND previous.envelope->'profile'=v_current
     AND previous.envelope->>'classificationState'='READY'
     AND previous.envelope->'canAccept'='true'::jsonb
     AND previous.created_at<=v_saved.created_at AND v_saved.created_at<=previous.expires_at
     AND binding.bound_at>=v_saved.created_at
     AND binding.result->>'status'='BOUND_WORKER_SERVICES'
     AND binding.result->>'workerProfileId'=s.profile_id::text
     AND batch.result->>'status'='COMMITTED' AND batch.result->'requiresBinding'='true'::jsonb
     AND batch.catalog_version=binding.catalog_version
     AND batch.plans=previous.envelope->'classificationCandidates'
     AND batch.review_digest=previous.envelope->>'displayedContentDigest'
     AND batch.review_digest=encode(extensions.digest(
       ((previous.envelope-'displayedContentDigest')||
         jsonb_build_object('baseHash',previous.base_hash))::text,'sha256'),'hex')
     AND jsonb_typeof(previous.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes')='array'
     AND jsonb_typeof(batch.result->'items')='array'
     AND jsonb_array_length(previous.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes') BETWEEN 1 AND 24
     AND jsonb_array_length(previous.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes')=jsonb_array_length(batch.plans)
     AND jsonb_array_length(batch.plans)=jsonb_array_length(batch.result->'items')
     AND binding.result->'serviceModeCount'=to_jsonb(jsonb_array_length(batch.plans))
     AND choice.modes=ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT item->>'mode'
       FROM jsonb_array_elements(previous.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes') item ORDER BY item->>'mode');
   IF FOUND THEN
     FOR v_item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_previous.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes') LOOP
       -- Keep independent surviving skills. Removed or ambiguous services never
       -- inherit a binding; adding an unmapped skill does not erase another one.
       IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.candidate->'skills') skill(value)
           WHERE skill.value=to_jsonb(v_item->>'service'))
          OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.candidate->'skills') skill(value)
              WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(skill.value#>>'{}')=
                    private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(v_item->>'service'))<>1
       THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
       SELECT count(*),min(category.id::text)::uuid INTO v_count,v_category
       FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_previous.batch_result->'items') admitted(value)
       JOIN private.work_taxonomy_categories category ON category.id::text=admitted.value->>'categoryId'
       JOIN private.work_taxonomy_category_modes scope ON scope.category_id=category.id
         AND scope.execution_scope=v_item->>'mode'
       JOIN private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 mode
         ON mode.worker_account_id=p_account_id AND mode.category_id=category.id
         AND mode.execution_scope=scope.execution_scope AND mode.active
         AND mode.source_review_id=v_saved.review_id AND mode.source_request_key=v_saved.client_request_id
         AND mode.confirmed_at=v_previous.bound_at
       JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities capability
         ON capability.worker_account_id=p_account_id AND capability.category_id=category.id
         AND NOT capability.excluded AND capability.origin='WORKER_CONFIRMED'
         AND capability.confirmed_at=v_previous.bound_at AND capability.updated_at<=v_previous.bound_at
       WHERE admitted.value->>'service'=v_item->>'service'
         AND admitted.value->>'mode'=v_item->>'mode'
         AND v_item->>'mode' IN ('ON_SITE','REMOTE')
         AND category.state='ESTABLISHED'
         AND (category.canonical_key=private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(v_item->>'service')
           OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_aliases alias
             WHERE alias.category_id=category.id
               AND alias.normalized_key=private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(v_item->>'service')));
       IF v_count<>1 THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
       v_projection:=private.taxonomy_review_exact_projection_v1('WORKER_CAPABILITY',
         jsonb_build_array(v_item->>'service'),jsonb_build_array(
           jsonb_build_object('service',v_item->>'service','mode',v_item->>'mode')));
       IF v_projection->>'status'='READY'
          AND v_projection#>>'{classificationCandidates,0,categoryId}'=v_category::text
       THEN
         select m.handoff into v_handoff from private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 m
          where m.worker_account_id=p_account_id and m.category_id=v_category
            and m.execution_scope=v_item->>'mode' and m.active
            and m.source_review_id=v_saved.review_id and m.source_request_key=v_saved.client_request_id;
         v_saved_services:=v_saved_services||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
         'service',v_item->>'service','mode',v_item->>'mode','categoryId',v_category)
          ||case when v_handoff is not null then jsonb_build_object('handoff',v_handoff) else '{}'::jsonb end);
       END IF;
     END LOOP;
   END IF;
 END IF;

 -- Latest current-source hints are separate proposals. Even an exact category
 -- and mode here are not saved consent and must never replace the baseline.
 v_source:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(
   s.candidate::text||'|'||s.revision::text||'|'||s.base_hash,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');
 SELECT h.proposals INTO v_hints FROM private.work_taxonomy_gemini_turn_hints_v1 h
 WHERE h.purpose='WORKER_CAPABILITY' AND h.account_id=p_account_id
   AND h.conversation_id=p_conversation_id AND h.source_fingerprint=v_source
   AND h.catalog_version=(SELECT catalog_version FROM private.work_taxonomy_control WHERE singleton=true)
 ORDER BY h.created_at DESC,h.id DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF jsonb_typeof(v_hints)='array' THEN
   FOR v_item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_hints) LOOP
     IF v_item->>'action' IS DISTINCT FROM 'REUSE_EXISTING'
        OR v_item->>'mode' NOT IN ('ON_SITE','REMOTE')
        OR v_item->>'categoryId' IS NULL
        OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.candidate->'skills') skill(value)
          WHERE skill.value=to_jsonb(v_item->>'service'))
        OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.candidate->'skills') skill(value)
            WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(skill.value#>>'{}')=
                  private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(v_item->>'service'))<>1
     THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
     v_projection:=private.taxonomy_review_exact_projection_v1('WORKER_CAPABILITY',
       jsonb_build_array(v_item->>'service'),jsonb_build_array(
         jsonb_build_object('service',v_item->>'service','mode',v_item->>'mode')));
     IF v_projection->>'status'='READY'
        AND v_projection#>>'{classificationCandidates,0,categoryId}'=v_item->>'categoryId'
     THEN v_draft_services:=v_draft_services||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
       'service',v_item->>'service','mode',v_item->>'mode','categoryId',v_item->>'categoryId')
        ||case when v_item ? 'handoff' then jsonb_build_object('handoff',v_item->'handoff') else '{}'::jsonb end);
     END IF;
   END LOOP;
 END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value->>'service',value->>'mode',value->>'categoryId'),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO v_saved_services FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_saved_services)) rows;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value->>'service',value->>'mode',value->>'categoryId'),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO v_draft_services FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_draft_services)) rows;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value#>>'{}'),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_unresolved
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT skill.value FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.candidate->'skills') skill(value)
   WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_saved_services||v_draft_services) known(value)
     WHERE known.value->>'service'=skill.value#>>'{}')) unresolved;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion','WORKER_SERVICE_MODE_CONTEXT_V1','revision',s.revision,
   'savedServices',v_saved_services,'draftServices',v_draft_services,'unresolvedServices',v_unresolved);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.metadata_text_array(value jsonb)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(item), ARRAY[]::text[])
  FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) = 'array' THEN value ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
  ) AS item;
$function$
